title: DecentraLabs FMI bindings for glTF nodes, version 1.0.0
description: Schema for the value of nodes[*].extras.fmiBindings in a glTF 2.0 or GLB asset. FMU-dependent semantics are validated separately.
$comment: Apply this schema to the fmiBindings value on a glTF node. Unknown properties are ignored by version 1.0.0 readers. See fmi-glb-bindings-contract.md for normative semantics.

variable.description: Exact FMI variable name declared by the selected FMU.

scale.description: Multiplier in sceneValue = fmiValue * scale + offset. Draggable inputs require a non-zero value.

offset.description: Offset in sceneValue = fmiValue * scale + offset.

visibleWhenGreaterThanOrEqual.description: Optional numeric threshold used only with target visible.

trueColor.description: Optional Three.js color string or 24-bit hexadecimal color integer used for a true-like FMI value.

falseColor.description: Optional Three.js color string or 24-bit hexadecimal color integer used for a false-like FMI value.
